name: The Cook in the Cage
summary: Wendel asks you to free him from a cage in the Kurzen compound. He needs a key and a disguise to slip away.

sections.title: Wendel's Plea
sections.body: Wendel is trapped in the Kurzen compound after an ambush in the jungle. He fears what his captors may do and asks you to find a key for his cage and a disguise to help him escape.

faq.q: Who is trapped in the cage?
faq.answer: Wendel is an explorer who was ambushed in the jungle and taken prisoner.
Wendel is held in a cage within the Kurzen compound.
Wendel asks you to find a key for his cage and a disguise so he can sneak out.
Wendel has heard talk of tigers and headshrinkers, but does not know what his captors plan to do with him.
